### When Christ Brings a Sword to Your Relationships
Author: Emily Rose Massey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/when-christ-brings-a-sword-to-your-relationships.html
Passage: Matthew 10:34-35
Points:
- Standing firmly on biblical truth can trigger painful division, even ending long-cherished friendships.
- Jesus explicitly cautioned that His truth draws a dividing line between those who follow Him and those who do not.
- Genuine discipleship calls believers to prioritize Christ above all earthly relationships and worldly approval.
- In seasons of rejection and grief, believers can find comfort and enduring purpose in Christ's faithful presence.

### The Great Divide
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-august-6-2026.html
Passage: Luke 12:51
Points:
- Jesus’ warning of division seems to contradict the angels’ proclamation of peace, yet both are true.
- Being reconciled to God radically transforms a believer's inner core, values, and life direction.
- Living out heaven's priorities inevitably exposes spiritual conflict and provokes friction, even within households.
- Although Christ's ultimate goal is eternal harmony, walking with Him now requires accepting the cost of division.
